display_name.description: The display name for the account on this mandate.

network_status.description: The status of the mandate on the Bacs network. Can be one of `pending`, `revoked`, `refused`, or `accepted`.

reference.description: The unique reference identifying the mandate on the Bacs network.

revocation_reason.description: When the mandate is revoked on the Bacs network this field displays the reason for the revocation.

service_user_number.description: The service user number for the account on this mandate.

url.description: The URL that will contain the mandate that the customer has signed.
